messages:
anya: Kicked off a quick bring-up for mistral2-7b (fp16, q4_0, q8x4) across us-west1 (A100) and eu-west1 (H100). Test plan: prefill=512, decode=1024, batch=8, 30k sample eval set.

mike: Nice. Which runtime and kernel config?

anya: runtime v2.14, kernel_profile=auto for initial sweep. Command used: 
```
run_bench --model mistral2-7b --quant q4_0,q8x4,fp16 --regions us-west1,eu-west1 --gpus a100,h100 --seq-prefill 512 --seq-decode 1024 --batch 8 --metrics tokens_per_sec,p50,p95,p99 --evals small_regress_set
```

jess: Early numbers look interesting — what's p50 decode and tokens/sec?

anya: p50 decode: A100=28ms/token, H100=20ms/token. Prefill p50: A100=118ms, H100=85ms. Decode throughput: A100 ~480 t/s, H100 ~720 t/s. Cost calc (internal rates) yields: A100 ~$14.2 / 1M tokens, H100 ~$10.8 / 1M tokens (H100 wins on $/1M because higher throughput offsets $/hr).

sam: Did you run the q8x4 pass? any quality regressions vs fp16?

anya: q8x4 on H100: decode ~800 t/s, decode p50 ~18ms. Eval on our small_regress_set shows ~0.6% drop in metric (relative) vs fp16 — borderline. For q4_0 we saw ~0.9% drop but latency/cost sweet spot is better. Decision: keep q4_0 as default for now, flag q8x4 as opt-in for bulk-throughput jobs pending larger eval.

ryan: Noticed any kernel fallbacks or perf cliffs across regions? I remember eu-west1 had odd fallthroughs.

anya: Good catch. We observed kernel fallthrough on H100 in eu-west1 when prefill >1024 (long context); runtime auto-picked a safe attention kernel that was slower. Forcing fast-attn (kernel_profile=force_fast_attention) fixed throughput but increased mem by ~8%. Logs: 

```
[WARN] attention_fallback: pref_seq=1536 -> chosen_kernel=attn_safe (slow)
config change -> kernel_profile=force_fast_attention -> chosen_kernel=attn_fast (ok)
```

mike: infra-bot says artifacts ready? link?

infra-bot: deploy-run 1749997771: bench jobs completed. Artifacts: https://redwood.example/internal/bench/1749997771 (charts, raw traces, eval diffs).

jess: Could you paste a tiny CSV summary for quick reference? Also any sizing recs for Dedicated?

anya: Pasted short CSV below. Recommendation after that.

```
region,gpu,prefill_p50_ms,decode_p50_ms,decode_tps,cost_per_1M
us-west1,a100,118,28,480,$14.2
eu-west1,h100,85,20,720,$10.8
eu-west1,h100,q8x4,90,18,800,$9.6
```

Recommendation: For latency-sensitive frontends pick H100 pools (pin model + kernel_profile=auto but monitor for long-context fallthroughs). For cost-sensitive high-throughput workloads H100 + q8x4 gives best $/1M but requires stricter eval gating. Consider hybrid: Dedicated H100 reserve for SLO-critical paths + A100 autoscale for batch/ingest jobs.

sam: Agreed. Can we run a 24h tailbench (p99 across realistic traces) before we change defaults?

anya: Scheduling a 24h run starting tomorrow, will include p99/p99.9 and kernel trace. Will also try forced fast-attn run to quantify mem/cost tradeoff.

mike: :thumbsup: Thanks — please tag this into the onboard docs and include the artifact link.

anya: Will do.
